initial.title: Observation notes
initial.summary: Ten short notes form one continuous reading sequence. Review them once, then compare the replacement revision.

sections.title: Opening note
sections.body: Start with a single purpose. Keep the opening note specific enough to recognize later.

sections.title: Scope note
sections.body: Name the edges of the work. A short boundary makes the rest of the notes easier to read.

sections.title: Order note
sections.body: Put the next useful idea after the current one. Readers should be able to follow the sequence.

sections.title: Detail note
sections.body: Keep one concrete detail close to each main point. Separate details that serve different purposes.

sections.title: Pause note
sections.body: Leave a clear pause between groups. A little space helps the reader find the next section.

sections.title: Review note
sections.body: Read the notes once from top to bottom. Mark the review only after considering the whole sequence.

sections.title: Continuity note
sections.body: Keep the current review count when the caller supplies a new revision of these notes.

sections.title: Context note
sections.body: A replacement can change the title and summary while leaving the same component mounted.

sections.title: Reach note
sections.body: The final sections should remain reachable. Long content must keep its ordinary reading order.

sections.title: Closing note
sections.body: Finish with a clear end note. The revision and review count should agree with the current state.

updates.title: Revised observation notes
updates.summary: The caller supplied revision B. The notes remain in the same component, and the completed review stays visible.

execution.scope_limit: Full execution retains the business route; targeted execution keeps its original action prefix and indices. Original parent expectations stay fixed; omitted states are unverified.
